I'm Hoang-Trung Le-Pham, a teaching assistant at the University of Information Technology, VNU-HCM, and an AI researcher with the IEC Research Group. My work explores model security, machine unlearning, and multimodal learning.

Research focus

Trustworthy intelligence, from models to systems.

I study how AI systems can remain useful while becoming safer, more private, and more robust in the real world.

01

Machine Unlearning

Removing the influence of selected training data while preserving model utility and measuring what the model still reveals.

02

AI Model Security

Investigating inversion, dropout, and bit-flip attacks—and designing stronger evaluation and defense mechanisms.

03

Multimodal Learning

Combining semantic, graph, interaction, and temporal signals for robust early rumor detection on social media.
